domains.name: Understanding Dance Production, and the Dance Industry
Organizational Requirements for Occupational Health and Safety in the Dance Industry.

standards.text: The learner demonstrates understanding of the roles of dance artists, dance production processes, professional practices, and ethical standards through apprenticeship experiences within dance organizations and creative industry settings.

The learners can synthesize apprenticeship experiences that reflect dance knowledge, skills, and professional work ethics in the learners’ chosen field through work performance and creative documentation. 1

contentStandards.text: The learner demonstrates understanding of the roles of dance artists, dance production processes, professional practices, and ethical standards through apprenticeship experiences within dance organizations and creative industry settings.

performanceStandards.text: The learners can synthesize apprenticeship experiences that reflect dance knowledge, skills, and professional work ethics in the learners’ chosen field through work performance and creative documentation. 1

competencies.text: discuss the interdisciplinary roles and responsibilities of dance artists and dance professionals, the functions of arts organizations, and the chain of accountability in dance production settings;
explain the creative and work processes involved in dance production;
practice safety and security procedures related to the dance, including physical and emotional wellbeing;
analyze how professional, corporate social responsibility, and ethical practices can be applied in the dance industry;
